appliances.name: Appliances & Furniture
appliances.desc: Household appliances and furniture placed inside buildings - kitchen appliances, laundry, outdoor cooking, and living/bedroom furniture, each with real-world dimensions for interior space planning.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.desc: Kitchen appliances in stainless, white and black, cabinets, counters, islands, tables, chairs, cookware and accessories: procedural low-poly models with real detail, separate from the general appliances and furniture.

living.name: Living Room
living.desc: Sofas, chairs, tables, shelves, lamps, rugs and decor for the living and family room, each in a classic and a modern style and four colours: procedural low-poly models, separate from the general appliances and furniture.

lighting.name: Lighting
lighting.desc: Ceiling lights, chandeliers and fans, inside and outside wall lights, and garden post, pole and path lights, each in a classic and a modern style and four metal finishes.
